text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared repository. Each time they do this, automated builds start automatically. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. By doing this often, teams can catch issues early, before they become big problems. CI pipelines make this process smooth by automating each step, from building to testing. This helps developers save time and avoid mistakes. As a result, software becomes more reliable and teams can deliver updates faster. CI is now a key part of modern software development.
